gloss: to wrap up, to envelop, to enfold

definitions.gloss: to wrap up, to envelop, to enfold
definitions.explanation: To completely wrap or enclose something, surrounding it entirely. Used both literally (wrapping an object) and figuratively (enveloping someone in warmth, kindness, or atmosphere).

examples.japanese: {毛布|もうふ}で{体|からだ}を{包|つつ}み{込|こ}んだ。
examples.english: I wrapped my body up in a blanket.

examples.japanese: {母|はは}が{子|こ}どもを{優|やさ}しく{包|つつ}み{込|こ}んだ。
examples.english: The mother gently enfolded her child.

examples.japanese: {山|やま}の{上|うえ}は{霧|きり}に{包|つつ}み{込|こ}まれて{何|なに}も{見|み}えなかった。
examples.english: The mountaintop was enveloped in fog and nothing was visible.

notes:
Compound of {包|つつ}む (to wrap) + {込|こ}む (into). The {込|こ}む suffix adds the nuance of wrapping thoroughly and completely, surrounding something on all sides. Frequently used in figurative/poetic descriptions.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・〜で{包|つつ}み{込|こ}む (to envelop with/in ~)
・〜に{包|つつ}み{込|こ}まれる (to be enveloped in ~)
・{優|やさ}しく{包|つつ}み{込|こ}む (to gently envelop)
・{光|ひかり}に{包|つつ}み{込|こ}まれる (to be bathed in light)
